description.value:
Cost 2 Zeal

Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points.

Frequency once per day

Immediately Cast a Rite for free after dropping a foe.

Immediately Cast a Rite you know as a free action, targeting only a creature within 30 feet; its Zeal cost is unchanged. Wrath is never quite finished when it looks finished.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Cost 2 Zeal, Trigger reduce a creature to 0 HP, Frequency 1/day: immediately Cast a known Rite as a free action at a creature within 30 feet, cost unchanged" is bucket 3: a limited-use trigger granting a wholly new usable action. Action/reaction-granting has no rule-element hook regardless of precedent, per this pass's fixed convention -- also separately blocked by P-ZEAL for the Cost 2 Zeal clause.
